lines.trans: Dima, do not push, you cannot just walk out of a restaurant.
First I need to appoint someone in my place.
Chef, have you read my plan yet?
Here, meet him, I will try this fellow out.
He even drew up a kitchen optimization plan.
By the way, I have always liked him a lot.
Kitchen, attention, I am appointing Lavrov head chef!
For now only on a trial period, for one day.
Lyova, I will explain everything to you later.
That is all, guys, keep working calmly!
I urgently need to sort out some paperwork.

words.gloss: to sort out, to figure out

meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'должать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to continue', paired with 'продолжить'.

examples.trans: Look, we continue saving on ingredients.

examples.text: Всё, ребята, продолжайте спокойно работать!
examples.trans: That is all, guys, keep working calmly!

examples.text: Операцию продолжаем.
examples.trans: We're continuing the operation.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'покойно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Всё, ребята, продолжайте спокойно работать!
examples.trans: That is all, guys, keep working calmly!

examples.text: И просто спокойно идёшь своей дорогой.
examples.trans: And simply walk calmly along your own road.

examples.text: Вы спокойно всё сделаете.
examples.trans: You'll do everything calmly.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to work', paired with 'поработать'.

examples.text: Всё, ребята, продолжайте спокойно работать!
examples.trans: That is all, guys, keep working calmly!

examples.text: Это я дала тебе шанс работать в престижном отеле!
examples.trans: I was the one who gave you a chance to work in a prestigious hotel!

examples.text: Я работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I work as mayor.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary
meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Дима, говори прямо, чего тебе надо?
examples.trans: Dima, speak plainly, what do you want?

examples.text: Мне надо срочно с бумагами разобраться.
examples.trans: I urgently need to sort out some paperwork.

examples.text: В Москве, малыш, надо уметь крутиться.
examples.trans: In Moscow, kiddo, you have to know how to hustle.

meanings.en: urgently, right away; predicative: it is urgent
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'рочно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Мне срочно нужно больше зарабатывать.
examples.trans: I urgently need to earn more money.

examples.text: Мне надо срочно с бумагами разобраться.
examples.trans: I urgently need to sort out some paperwork.

examples.text: Павел Юрьевич, это срочно!
examples.trans: Pavel Yuryevich, this is urgent!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'with / from', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Димочка, ну не расстраивайся ты так.
examples.trans: Dimochka, well do not get so upset.

examples.text: У меня сейчас сплошные нервы и стресс.
examples.trans: I have nothing but nerves and stress right now.

examples.text: Я новый контракт не могу подписать.
examples.trans: I cannot sign a new contract.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'paper; official document' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Мне надо срочно с бумагами разобраться.
examples.trans: I urgently need to sort out some paperwork.

examples.text: Вот бумага из прокуратуры.
examples.trans: Here is a document from the prosecutor's office.

examples.text: Подпишите эту бумагу.
examples.trans: Sign this paper.

разобраться.gloss: to sort out, to figure out

meanings.en: to sort out, to settle, to deal with
meanings.note: Prefix 'раз-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'обраться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to sort out, to figure out', paired with 'разбираться'.

examples.text: Мне надо срочно с бумагами разобраться.
examples.trans: I urgently need to sort out some paperwork.

examples.text: Аникеев, иди к себе, а мы разберёмся.
examples.trans: Anikeev, go to your room, and we'll sort this out.

examples.text: Я скоро во всём разберусь.
examples.trans: I'll figure everything out soon.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'пасибо'). Common neuter noun meaning 'thank you' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Спасибо за доверие, я вас не подведу!
examples.trans: Thank you for the trust, I will not let you down!

examples.text: Спасибо, ребята, я сам не ожидал!
examples.trans: Thank you, guys, I did not expect it myself!

examples.text: Спасибо, папа!
examples.trans: Thanks, Dad!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'for', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Если не нужен, может, назад его вернёшь?
examples.trans: If you do not need him, maybe you will give him back?

examples.text: Забирай, конечно, если он сам согласится.
examples.trans: Take him, of course, if he agrees himself.

examples.text: И как содержать дочку на зарплату повара?
examples.trans: And how do I support a daughter on a cook's salary?

meanings.note: Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'верие'). Common neuter noun meaning 'trust' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Спасибо за доверие, я вас не подведу!
examples.trans: Thank you for the trust, I will not let you down!

examples.text: Спасибо за доверие!
examples.trans: Thank you for your trust!

examples.text: Это вопрос доверия.
examples.trans: It's a question of trust.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'вести'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'will let down', paired with 'подводить'.

examples.text: Я вас никогда не подведу.
examples.trans: I will never let you down.

examples.text: Надёжный друг никогда не подведёт в беде.
examples.trans: A reliable friend will never let you down in trouble.

examples.text: Подведём итоги твоей первой рабочей недели.
examples.trans: Let us sum up your first work week.
